title: The overnight success that took 7 years
format: Spotlight style (like cryothum): result-first hook, rewind, 'Imagine someone', principle, maxim, title card

beats.text: Nobody becomes successful overnight. They just stop being invisible overnight.
Imagine someone playing his first open mic. Three people in the room. Two of them are on their phones.
He comes back the next week. And the week after that.
For two years, nobody remembers his name.
His friends get promotions, new apartments, weekends off.
And at every family dinner, someone asks when he'll get a real job.
By year five, he has played more than 250 shows for almost nobody.
Then, in year seven, one clip from one ordinary night gets posted online.
By the next morning, millions of people know his name.
And every headline calls it luck.
But luck can only find you on stage if you never left it.
The world didn't discover him overnight. It just finally caught up.
